legalBasis: Affordable Housing Act, 2024 & Tax Laws (Amendment) Act, 2024
taxReliefDescription: Under the Tax Laws (Amendment) Act, 2024 (effective 27 Dec 2024), the employee's 1.5% Housing Levy contribution is deducted directly from gross pay as an allowable pre-tax deduction before calculating PAYE.
notes: The Affordable Housing Levy (AHL) is governed by the Affordable Housing Act, 2024 (enacted March 2024)
Both employer and employee each contribute 1.5% of gross monthly salary (total 3% remitted to KRA)
Effective 27 December 2024 under the Tax Laws (Amendment) Act, 2024, the employee's 1.5% contribution is a full pre-tax allowable deduction when computing taxable income for PAYE
Contributions are remitted through KRA iTax by the 9th working day of the following month
Non-salaried / self-employed individuals also contribute 1.5% of their gross income
Proceeds fund the Affordable Housing Programme (Boma Yangu) across all 47 counties
